item.name: Basic Ball
item.howToGet: Default ball every player has in unlimited supply
item.bestUse: Catching common, low-rarity Evomon while you build up coins and better balls.
item.cardSummary: The free starter ball every player carries without limit. It has a standard catch rate and no talent or rarity bonus, so it is meant for early common catches rather than rare targets.

item.name: Advanced Ball
item.effect: Stronger catch chance, no talent bonus
item.howToGet: Buy with Coins in the Coin Shop, or claim from codes
item.bestUse: General farming and improving your odds on rarer Evomon when premium balls are scarce.
item.cardSummary: A purchasable upgrade over the Basic Ball with a stronger catch chance but no talent guarantee. It is the main code-reward ball and the workhorse for everyday catching of rarer Evomon.

item.name: King Ball
item.effect: Guarantees SSS talent on the catch
item.howToGet: Weekly Daily Quest reward and Season Battle Pass levels (4-5 from the free track)
item.bestUse: Securing an SSS-talent catch on bosses and rare spawns when you do not need the sparkling effect.
item.cardSummary: A premium ball that guarantees the captured Evomon has the top SSS talent. Earned from weekly Daily Quests and the Battle Pass, it is the go-to for locking in SSS talent on tough or rare targets.

item.name: Prismatic Ball
item.effect: Guarantees the catch, SSS talent, and a random sparkling effect
item.howToGet: Season Battle Pass levels (1 from completion) or buy for 799 Robux each (pack of 10 for 7,990 Robux)
item.bestUse: Endgame captures of the strongest or rarest Evomon when you want a guaranteed SSS, sparkling catch.
item.cardSummary: The top-tier ball with a guaranteed 100% catch, a guaranteed SSS talent, and a random sparkling effect. It is the premium choice for the strongest Evomon, earned from the Battle Pass or bought with Robux.
